details: Malicious package. An install script runs `node index.js`, which executes `hostname`, `whoami`, `hostname -I` and `date` and posts the results to a Telegram bot (`api.telegram.org`). Observed in a sandboxed install. `index.js` (sha256 fba01e6f8d33065d3cbf549eaece41c5c28fbf0f54ef833cab3c4ce555cd2c93) is identical to the file in `@0xme5war/apicli` (MAL-2025-6684) and `inditextech` (MAL-2025-6349). Published 2025-07-28 and unpublished from npm within an hour.
